svg.aria-label: Dividing in scientific notation: divide the coefficients and subtract the exponents of 10. 2 times 10 to the 8 divided by 4 times 10 cubed gives 0.5 times 10 to the 5. Because 0.5 is less than 1, make the coefficient 10 times bigger and the exponent 1 smaller: 5 times 10 to the 4.
